dashboard_period: Since launch · dashboard view: Last 1 Year

highlights.title: A single-player request was converted from earliest availability
highlights.summary: A caller asked for the earliest nine-hole tee time that day. SpeakSport found the 2:10 PM slot, completed the walking reservation and answered the caller’s follow-up question about whether they might be paired with other golfers.
highlights.quote: “The earliest available tee time for 9 holes today is 2:10 PM.” SpeakSport then confirmed the booking and explained the likely pairing experience for a single player.

highlights.title: An unavailable request became a confirmed nearby option
highlights.summary: When a two-player request for 10:30 AM could not be accommodated, SpeakSport clearly gave the next available choices. The caller selected 11:50 AM and the nine-hole cart booking was confirmed without a staff handoff.
highlights.quote: “Our first available tee time for 9 holes today is at 11:50 AM. After that we have 2:10, 2:20 and 2:30.”

highlights.title: Booking details were clarified before confirmation
highlights.summary: A three-player group asked for 18 holes at 10:40 AM and initially gave an unclear response about carts. SpeakSport checked the detail, captured the group’s correction to riding, verified availability and confirmed the requested time.
highlights.quote: “Thank you for clarifying. I’ll mark your group as riding in carts.” SpeakSport then confirmed three players at 10:40 AM.

features_intro: We have continued strengthening the integrated experience around booking accuracy, reservation servicing and clearer operational insight.

features.title: Cancellations on the call
features.description: Golfers can now cancel eligible bookings directly with SpeakSport, reducing avoidable transfers and making it easier to release tee times promptly.

features.title: Stronger booking-eligibility verification
features.description: Booking windows, customer context and other applicable booking rules are checked before a reservation is created.

features.title: Upcoming-booking confirmations
features.description: When golfers ask about an upcoming reservation, SpeakSport can retrieve and confirm the booking details during the call.

features.title: Richer back-office reporting
features.description: The dashboard now supports filtering calls by intent, category and outcome, making performance patterns and operational opportunities easier to find.

future_note: We will continue enriching SpeakSport with capabilities such as self-serve knowledge-base updates and even better reporting. We would love The Meadows to remain part of that journey—please keep sharing feedback, ideas and initiatives you would like us to explore.

future_priorities.title: Self-serve knowledge base
future_priorities.description: Make it easier for your team to keep rates, policies, facility information and caller guidance current.

future_priorities.title: Even better reporting
future_priorities.description: Add clearer views of booking demand, eligibility, preferred playing times and caller outcomes.
